primary.why: ASKA is a Steam release from Sand Sailor Studio, with single-player and online co-op support. It is a Viking survival game built around growing and managing a self-sustaining tribe. No console or mobile release was found in this pass, so the Steam PC build is the only archive route. Because it remains Early Access, treat the recommendation as provisional until 1.0.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam Early Access build if an in-development archive capture is acceptable; otherwise wait for 1.0 and revalidate.

entries.remaster_caveats: Early Access game: revalidate at 1.0 before treating this as a final definitive archive route.
